title: Files
subtitle: {{name}} · its own folder
offline: The Machine is offline. You can change this once it is back.

missing.title: Agent not found
missing.body: The Machine may not have listed its Agents yet, or this Agent is gone.

older.title: This Machine cannot give folders yet
older.body: Update the Runtime on the Machine first, then the Agent can read folders you pick on it.

folders.heading: Selected folders
folders.footer: Enter the full path of a folder on the Machine. The Machine checks that it exists and is not where secrets are kept. One Agent at a time may write a folder.
folders.emptyDetail: The Agent still reads only its own Workdir.
folders.readOnly: Read only · tap to let it write
folders.readWrite: Read and write · tap to make it read only

invalid.title: Not a full path
invalid.body: Enter a full path starting with /, such as /Users/me/code/shop.

authenticate.folder: Keep {{name}} to its own folder again

folder.label: Its own folder
folder.footer: The Agent reads and writes only its own Workdir. Pick selected folders to let it work in a project already on the Machine, such as ~/code/shop, without cloning it again (ADR 0087).

selected.label: Selected folders
selected.footer: The Agent reads every file in the folders you pick and can send them out through its Egress. The home folder, .ssh, browser data and system folders can never be picked.

machine.label: Whole Machine
machine.footer: The Agent reads, changes and deletes every file the Runtime's user reaches, .ssh and browser data included, except the Runtime's own folder. It still goes out only through its Egress and asks for Approvals. Use it only for an Agent you instruct yourself.

machine.title: Give {{name}} the whole Machine?
machine.body: The Agent will read, change and delete every file on the Machine, .ssh, tokens and browser data included, except the Runtime's own folder. A page it reads could trick it into sending data out through its Egress.
